name: Policy enforcement point (PEP)
short_description: Architectural component that evaluates a request against policy synchronously and allows or denies the action before the state change commits; the counterpart to a policy decision point.

evidence.quote: A policy enforcement point, PEP is the moment a system evaluates intent and either allows an action or refuses it.
The deterministic policy gate that evaluates each action at the moment it is about to execute.
